# Risk Review: demo

A reviewer dashboard for a platform-agnostic user-behavior risk detector. It scores
how accounts behave over time and explains every flag in plain language.

**Everything here is simulated.** The users, posts and platforms are generated by the
project's simulator; no real person is shown or judged. Decisions you record are kept
only until the Space restarts, and sending new events is switched off.

Source code: https://github.com/Krishnatejaswini05/suspicious_user_detection
